roles.label: Viewer
roles.description: Can see everything in the workspace but cannot change it.

roles.label: Member
roles.description: Can create and edit work in the apps they have access to.

roles.label: Admin
roles.description: Can also invite and remove members and change workspace settings.

roles.label: Owner
roles.description: Full control, including billing and deleting the workspace.
roles.disabledReason: Only an owner can make someone an owner.

texts: Can see everything in the workspace but cannot change it.
